title: FENDER PANELS TO DASH PANEL
summary: How the front fender (front body side panel) is bonded to the dash panel (firewall area at the cowl): bond 'B' along the dash panel flanges and a fender inner tab, bond 'G' at the plenum panel filler, the lower outer windshield bonding strip and the dash extension. No callout parts and no mechanical fasteners.

fastening.note: Bond 'B' at the dash panel flanges (two places at the top) and at a tab on the inner fender; bond 'G' at the plenum panel filler, at the lower outer windshield (W/S) bonding strip, and at the dash extension.

notes_internal: Title block UPC box reads '11/13' (front end sheet metal); used verbatim as group.
No parts list; named items (dash panel, plenum panel filler, lower outer W/S bonding strip, dash extension, fender) have no part numbers here.
Bond 'B' and 'G' have no material legend on this page.
Circled 1 on the fender inner panel marks revision 1 (fender drawing revised).
Title block: L-82108, L-82110, L-82101; DR JM/C1, CK 5-2-69 C1, PREL 4-28-69, C/O A4 (handwritten, reads A4).
